bias.zh: 反弹 · 守住 10 日和 200 日均线，仍低于 $811–834

read.en: Micron fell 1.6% on Nov 12 to $798.44, trading $764.57–799.70. It is above the 5-day ($751.6), 10-day ($778.3) and rising 200-day ($763.9) and below the 30-day ($899.5) and 100-day ($945.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 30, below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($888.94), and RSI is 44.1.
read.zh: 美光 11月12日下跌 1.6%，收于 $798.44，盘中区间 $764.57–799.70。股价位于 5 日（$751.6）、10 日（$778.3）和上行的 200 日均线（$763.9）上方，30 日（$899.5）和 100 日均线（$945.7）下方。MACD 自 10月30日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄、趋近上穿；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$888.94），RSI 为 44.1。

read.en: No level changed: the dip to $764.57 held the 200-day and the close recovered to the day's high. Resistance is $811.3–827.6 (Nov 11 close and high), then $829–834 (Nov 2 low and close) and $845–855. Support is $778–795 (10-day, Nov 4 low and close), then $763–765 (200-day, Nov 11–12 lows) and $738–746. A close above $834 would target $845–855; below $778, $763.
